name: Sky Fighters
desc:
🗡️ Survive deadly games inspired by Sky Squid Game
🛡️ Obtain powers to defeat your opponents with ease

Unlock powers and survive through the three platforms to win the intense game.  

💻📱🎮 Works on all devices: PC, Console, Mobile.

PC Keybinds: 
Left Ctrl / Left Alt — Shift Lock
Q — Dash

SHUTDOWN = UPDATE
